pairs.title: The held-PR picture: GitHub draws it, then our renderer draws the same text
pairs.caption: The same diagram text both sides, generated by `node scripts/platter-picture.mjs open --count 3`.

before.label: live, as GitHub draws it
before.source:
--- title: "The held PR: the button decides what reverts" config: flowchart: nodeSpacing: 24 rankSpacing: 36 padding: 10 --- flowchart TD items@{ shape: docs, label: "**3 protected changes**
one commit each,
each verified green" } pr@{ shape: stadium, label: "**one held PR**
one click by Eric,
never auto-merged" } items ==> pr ==> button{"`**which button lands it?**
the click decides
what can be undone`"} button ==>|Create a merge commit| merged@{ shape: cyl, label: "**main: 3 commits**
any one item
reverts alone" } button -->|Squash and merge| squashed@{ shape: cyl, label: "**main: one commit**
an item reverts
by ship revert" } class items,pr,merged,squashed paper class button gold classDef paper fill:#F4EFE6,color:#141210,stroke:#141210,stroke-width:3px classDef gold fill:#E0A33A,color:#1A1300,stroke:#1A1300,stroke-width:3px classDef defect fill:#B3261E,color:#FFF4EC,stroke:#FFF4EC,stroke-width:3px classDef default font-size:20px,font-family:Verdana
